title.vi: RAG thực chiến: chia đoạn (chunking) và đo chất lượng truy xuất
title.en: Practical RAG: chunking and measuring retrieval quality

summary.vi: kích thước đoạn và chồng lấn, truy xuất TF-IDF, recall@k, MRR, lỗi thường gặp của RAG
summary.en: chunk size and overlap, TF-IDF retrieval, recall@k, MRR, common RAG failures

files.name: main.py
files.code:
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.metrics.pairwise import cosine_similarity

doc = ("Refunds are allowed within 30 days of purchase with a receipt. "
       "Shipping takes 3 to 5 business days inside the country. "
       "International shipping takes 10 to 15 business days and customs fees may apply. "
       "Gift cards never expire and cannot be exchanged for cash. "
       "Support is available by email from Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm.")

def chunk(text, size, overlap):
    words = text.split()
    step = size - overlap
    return [" ".join(words[i:i + size]) for i in range(0, max(1, len(words) - overlap), step)]

chunks = chunk(doc, size=14, overlap=4)
print("số đoạn:", len(chunks))

# Truy xuất: xếp hạng đoạn theo cosine TF-IDF với câu hỏi
vec = TfidfVectorizer().fit(chunks)
def retrieve(q, k=2):
    s = cosine_similarity(vec.transform([q]), vec.transform(chunks))[0]
    return list(s.argsort()[::-1][:k])

# Bộ kiểm thử nhỏ: câu hỏi -> từ khoá phải xuất hiện trong đoạn đúng
tests = [("how long do refunds take", "Refunds"), ("international shipping time", "International"), ("do gift cards expire", "Gift")]
hits, rr = 0, []
for q, key in tests:
    ranked = retrieve(q, k=len(chunks))
    pos = next((i for i, c in enumerate(ranked) if key in chunks[c]), None)
    hits += pos is not None and pos < 2
    rr.append(1 / (pos + 1) if pos is not None else 0)
print("recall@2:", hits / len(tests), "| MRR:", round(sum(rr) / len(rr), 2))

def chunk(text, size, overlap):
    words = text.split()
    step = size - overlap
    return [' '.join(words[i:i + size]) for i in range(0, max(1, len(words) - overlap), step)]

text = ' '.join(f'w{i}' for i in range(20))
c = chunk(text, 8, 2)
print(len(c))
print(len(c[-1].split()))

prompt.en: Given the rank at which the right item was found (starting at 1) as [1, 3, 2, 0] (0 = not found). Compute MRR = the mean of 1/rank (0 if not found) and print it rounded to 4 digits.
